review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for C. The original PRD explicitly fixes hypothetical DEC-001=OPT-1 without representing it as a human Decision; an empty human decision input is therefore consistent with ready and no blocking reasons. This does not resolve DEC-001 for paired B: a material unresolved decision there must block at decisions, before later review prerequisites. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001 and both task keys remain stable. Acceptance covers unchanged explicit rejection values and Error identity, explicit undefined versus omitted arguments, and preservation of running-task and rejectOnClear=false behavior. The complete supplied source evidence supports the exact four-file binding scope: index.js owns queue behavior, index.d.ts is the maintained public declaration, and test.js and index.test-d.ts are the existing runtime and type-regression owners. The limitFunction forwarding implementation and Pick-based declaration do not create additional mandatory edits. package.json establishes separate runtime and tsd checks through xo && ava && tsd, with no declaration-generation evidence requiring a different ownership treatment. TASK-VERIFY remains independent and dependent on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with all required acceptance criteria requiring both relationships. The allowed implementer and verifier have supplied active project-scoped trusted claims for the relevant API, shared-state/data, asynchronous-consumer, JavaScript/TypeScript and testing capabilities; testing.verification is present for the verifier. Pending security.authorization claims are not treated as trusted or necessary for this change. A distinct online project reviewer is configured, consistent with the supplied non-executing reviewer policy. The Gold and preview release fingerprints agree for repository, source, team, decision input, prompts, model, sampling, policy and budgets. The manifest-specific source digest is not assumed to be the aggregate release source digest. Original-specification preparation placeholders are supplemented by the supplied frozen preview and release input. Historical project reuse and its retained old operation do not establish candidate execution on this bundle; the supplied isolation record states that Gold precedes every candidate and supplies no historical candidate outputs. This approval concerns expectation coherence only, not execution, task dispatch, or a new human attestation. Digests and their input binding are accepted as Service-supplied; I did not recompute them or execute code.
